title: Offline Solana market/liquidity observation selection foundation
objective: Implement the offline market observation domain, deterministic selection rule, in-memory idempotent store, observation-backed MarketDataProvider, additive migration, and liquidity-aware large-order floor without calling any live market provider.
forbidden_actions: Do not call Dexscreener, GeckoTerminal, Birdeye, or any network market API.
Do not store credentials or raw provider payloads.
Do not let market enrichment override on-chain holder, creator, or Dev facts.
Do not activate BSC or Robinhood.
